Bitwarden CLI Compromise (Shai-Hulud V3)

Target: bitwarden-cli
Repository: https://github.com/bitwarden/clients
Date: 2026-04-22
Attribution: Advanced Persistent Threat
Component: Application
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Token Theft/Self-Propagation
User Impact: 100000
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The official Bitwarden CLI npm package (@bitwarden/cli) was compromised to distribute the Shai-Hulud worm payload. The malicious version (2026.4.0) stole credentials and automatically backdoored every npm package the victim had permission to publish.

Compromised Versions

  • 2026.4.0
